english.meaning: for a route to go through or reach a place
english.note: 冇路通羅馬 means no road leads to Rome.

exampleSentences.english: I guess there’s no way to get to Rome from here.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我諗哩度冇路通羅馬啩。
